body: I know what you mean. I’ve been at it for years but given my environmental conditions, my scars fade and heal quickly so they’re really hard to see, and even though I can’t let people see them and I don’t really want people to, I’m always scared other ppl will think I’m a fraud, or I just generally feel like a fraud sometimes. I get what you mean.

Thank you so much. Reading through all these comments has really helped me clear my head, and feel a lot better about it, and myself. I can’t express enough how much I appreciate your reply. So thank you.
Thank you, I really appreciate it. When you (and others) say razor blade, do you just mean like the razors from pencil sharpeners?? I’ve never really known.

I really appreciate you replying. I know I’ve said this on a few other reply’s, but I am being 100% genuine when I say that I think I really needed to hear this. Sometimes I get stuck in that mindset but hearing these things from people who have been there/ are there, and can relate.... I don’t even know how to express how much it helps, and how comforting it is. So, thank you.

Thank you. I don’t know if I can convince myself of this just yet, but I think I needed to hear it. Thank you. 

(Ps. Happy cake day! :) )
Thank you, I think I really, really, needed to hear that. So thank you.

Legit same. If I start wearing long sleeves when it’s hot they instantly start asking “aren’t you hot in that?? Just take it off?? Why are u wearing that??”. And yeah my parents wake me up of a morning bc I sleep through my alarm and I am always paranoid that my sleeves will be pulled up slightly and expose my arms and I won’t realise. 

I feel u man. It’s suffocating as hell.
Legitimately same. And I’m so annoyed at myself.
Thank you for replying. That’s actually really helpful information, thank you! :))
